_note: Mine Hut on the Mine Hut kit (SGODOT-308, 刘备 #438; q(193) / q(204)): Ivo's home in a highland city, no keeper and no counter. Room metres of assets/rooms/mine_hut/layout.json (its suggested_anchors; 上官婉儿 on 284), floor top y 0.082, ground 6.8 × 6.4. Ivo stands by the sealed old shaft, turned to the room and the door (160°; the kit's suggested 45° had his back to the camera, checked in the room in the game); the player talks to him from stand_ivo. Where the player can walk comes from the kit's colliders (P0RoomNav), not this file.
